subject: 📚 Book Checkout Confirmation - University Library
body:
Dear $student_name,

Your book has been successfully checked out from the University Library.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CHECKOUT DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Book Title: $book_title
Book ID: $book_id
Checkout Date: $checkout_date
Due Date: $due_date
Loan Period: $loan_period days

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

IMPORTANT REMINDERS:
• Please return the book by the due date to avoid late fees
• Late fee: £$late_fee per day after the due date
• You can renew the book online if no one else has reserved it
• Report any damage immediately to avoid being charged

Need to extend your loan?
Log into the library portal to renew online or contact us at library@university.edu

Thank you for using our library services!

Best regards,
University Library Team
